fieldValues.title: A process cannot declare what it needs
fieldValues.statement: A Protocol can say only which type a stage writes or which fields it fills. What a stage reads, which links it must write, whether it updates, computes or waits for a person, and whether it repeats per item all live in the runner's conventions. So the process does not travel whole with its package, and a second tool or model cannot run it the same way.
source_ref: srs-programme finding 554c8576 (nine things the minutes process needs)
